regime_context: Detector shows a narrow leadership regime (4/22 eligible themes) with Banks and Innovative Pharma/CXO as the two clear leaders, both crowded and with high durability bars. The absolute-trend gate did NOT hold on China A-shares history (gate_helps=false), so trend discipline is experimental here and the tape leans mean-reverting; rank-IC is ~0. Overall this is a display-only, discipline-not-prediction state with high unscheduled macro surprise share (0.4).
emerging_watch: Watching Coal (rank 6, eligible=true) as a potential confirmed handoff if its breadth expands from 0.3 and durability bar rises above 0.5 while Banks/Pharma lose eligibility — the mean-revert hurst tag makes it a candidate for mean-reversion support, not a call yet.

theses.subject: Banks
theses.thesis: Banks are the detector's leader (rank 1, score 0.998) with the highest durability bar (0.73) and strong breadth (0.889), suggesting a cohesive leadership story rather than a fragile one-name squeeze. However crowding is flagged (z=1.78, crowded=true) and the scoring edge is not predictive, so this is a directional lean on the existing leader, not a forecast.
evidence: crowded=true with crowding_z 1.78 — size-down caution only
theses.dissent: Mean-reverting tape in China A-shares (gate_helps=false) means the strongest recent leader is often the most vulnerable to a sharp pullback when flow rotates; breadth can compress quickly without a macro catalyst.

falsifier.text: Banks ETF 512800.SS lags the CSI 300 by 5% or more before the check-by date.

theses.subject: Innovative Pharma & CXO
theses.thesis: Pharma/CXO is the challenger theme (rank 2, score 0.988), nearly tied with Banks (rotation margin 0.01) and the only other eligible theme with meaningful durability (0.6). This close two-theme structure suggests leadership is contested but consolidated in these two; leaning with the challenger is reasonable given the tight margin, though the crowding flag (z=1.59) argues for caution.
theses.dissent: Crowding (z=1.59) in a mean-reverting market may indicate late-cycle attention; a confirmed handoff to Banks or a de-risking shock would hit Pharma/CXO harder given its thinner breadth.

falsifier.text: Pharma/CXO ETF 159992.SZ lags the CSI 300 by 5% or more before the check-by date.

theses.subject: AI Compute & Optics
theses.thesis: AI Compute & Optics is rank 3 but not eligible (score 0.682, eligible=false) with a very low durability bar (0.28) and near-zero breadth (0.059), indicating the trend is not confirmed and participation is extremely thin. In a mean-reverting tape where the trend gate has no drawdown edge, chasing a non-eligible theme with weak breadth adds risk without a validated edge.
theses.dissent: AI Compute is the only top-3 theme not crowded (z=-0.66) and carries a 'trend' hurst tag, so it could be an early-stage rotation candidate if breadth expands; avoiding may miss an inflection.

falsifier.text: AI Compute & Optics ETF 515000.SS becomes eligible (gate turns true) with breadth expanding above 0.5 before the check-by date.

macro_narrative.note: market-level macro/policy/geo narrative flow; coincident, not per-theme, never a trigger
